source_availability.classification_method: Plan contracts, LPC predicted paths, accelerate supervisor import sites, LFV completion receipts, and formal-planning matrix notes. Items requiring on-disk datasets AST confirmation set source_read=false.

invariants: Provider success is not semantic success.
v1 generic payloads cannot bypass BackendRequest@2.
Provider output stays untrusted until validation or reconstruction.
Advisors propose; they do not prove or raise authority.
Datasets owns cache-key semantics; supervisor owns placement and single-flight only.
Operation status, semantic verdict, availability, evidence kind, evidence authority, boundedness, and translation preservation are orthogonal axes.
Imports and declaration discovery perform no install, network, process, environment, or write side effects.
A structurally valid receipt is not authenticated evidence.
Simulated, stale, or authority-overclaiming evidence fails closed.

items.name: BackendRequest@2
items.role: Only admitted typed backend-request generation for new writes. Carries operation-specific fields, positive finite bounds, and cannot be bypassed by v1 generic payloads.
items.notes: Plan lists backends.requests_v2 among preserved strong contracts. LPC-051 explicitly forbids v1 generic payloads from bypassing this generation.

items.name: LogicObligation@2
items.role: Typed obligation feeding BackendRequest@2 on the canonical pipeline.
items.notes: Exact module file not confirmed without datasets source; classified as the pipeline stage immediately before BackendRequest@2.

items.name: BackendRequest (ir_core.protocols)
items.role: IR-core protocol symbol bound by supervisor DatasetsLogicBackendSpec IR surface. Not the plan-named BackendRequest@2 new-write generation.
items.notes: Supervisor backend probe requires BackendRequest on ir_core.protocols. Relationship to requests_v2 (alias, facade, or older generation) remains source-confirmation open; classified legacy relative to BackendRequest@2.

items.name: BackendRequest / provider payload v1 generic
items.role: Generic unrestricted JSON-style provider payloads retained only through explicit adapters. Must be parsed into an operation type, rejected, or retained as advisory.
items.notes: LPC-051 predicted adapter: protocol_v1_adapter.py. New writes use BackendRequest@2 / protocol v2.

items.name: LogicProviderProtocol@2
items.role: Planned operation-specific typed provider-protocol successor: capability, translation, prove/check, reconstruct, verify, and attest requests with positive finite bounds on executable ops.
items.notes: LPC-050 owns protocol_v2.py and tests. Inventory does not prove an equivalent successor already exists as a separate module; live wire remains LogicProvider@1 in backends.provider.

items.name: LogicProvider@1
items.role: Live datasets-owned provider wire contract (LogicProviderRequest / LogicProviderResponse and related types). Preserved strong contract and LFV-G015 reconciliation target.
items.notes: CANONICAL_LOGIC_PROVIDER_MODULE = ipfs_datasets_py.logic.backends.provider. LPC-G050 evidence path points here while predicting protocol_v2 as the typed successor; treat provider.py as live semantic wire until inventory proves protocol_v2 already supersedes it.

items.name: Supervisor ProofProvider protocol v1
items.role: Supervisor-owned execution envelope: ProviderRequest/ProviderResponse, protocol_version=1, six operations, resource budget, cancellation, network policy, fail-closed untrusted output.
items.notes: Operations: capability, translate, prove, reconstruct, verify, attest. Does not redefine datasets semantics; converts via SupervisorLogicProviderFacade.

items.name: SupervisorLogicProviderFacade@1
items.role: Lazy supervisor facade converting ProviderRequest to datasets LogicProviderRequest and validating LogicProviderResponse without importing datasets at import time.
items.notes: LFV-G015 interface pair with LogicProvider@1.

items.name: protocol_v1_adapter
items.role: Planned LPC-051 adapter so v1 generic payloads are operation-typed, rejected, or advisory-only and cannot bypass BackendRequest@2.
items.notes: Predicted path only until LPC-051 lands.

items.name: IpfsDatasetsLogicProvider (Hammer adapter)
items.role: Supervisor hammer/portfolio adapter over datasets hammers and backend probes. Candidate-producing until reconstruction; must not grant proof authority from unreconstructed success.
items.notes: Plan epic K: hammer adapter cleanup. Binds BackendRequest on ir_core.protocols and hammers modules.

items.name: logic.hammers
items.role: Datasets hammer surfaces: premise selection, portfolio, reconstruction, corpus. Separates candidate evidence from reconstruction and kernel authority.
items.notes: LPC-005 conflict policy lists hammers as read-only production surface.

items.name: LogicTranslationReceipt@1
items.role: Datasets-owned loss-aware cross-logic translation receipt binding source/target, compilers, assumptions, bounds, unsupported constructs, preservation claim, witnesses, semantic mutations, and authority ceiling.
items.notes: CANONICAL_RECEIPT_MODULE points at software_verification.receipts; adapter loads LogicTranslationReceipt.

items.name: software_verification.translations
items.role: Datasets translation compilers and preservation taxonomy projected by SupervisorCanonicalLogicAdapter.
items.notes: CANONICAL_TRANSLATION_MODULE. Maps supervisor TranslationClass onto PreservationKind / TranslationKind.

items.name: TranslationContract (supervisor)
items.role: Supervisor-local translation contract with LogicForm, TranslationClass, ApproximationDirection, SemanticInventory, and fail-closed validation. Projects onto datasets preservation taxonomy.
items.notes: TranslationClass values: exact, equisatisfiable, bounded_abstraction, conservative_approximation, heuristic. Heuristic caps assurance at unverified.

items.name: Translation preservation axis (planned)
items.role: Planned orthogonal translation-preservation axis distinct from operation status and semantic verdict (LPC-G030 / LPC-030).
items.notes: Live supervisor TranslationClass remains through explicit legacy mapping after axes land.

items.name: CanonicalProofPlan@1
items.role: Planned single datasets-owned proof-plan model for goal, interpretations, properties, assumptions, obligations, dependency graph, translations, lanes, reconstruction, bounds, fallbacks, status, and completeness boundary.
items.notes: Advisors may propose plans; they must not mark proved or raise authority (LPC-071).

items.name: tactician.planner
items.role: LPC-G070 evidence path for the datasets tactician planner that must host one plan model without a second independent tactician.
items.notes: Supervisor may reorder semantically valid lanes but must not rewrite their meaning.

items.name: ProofPlan (supervisor)
items.role: Supervisor-local deterministic acyclic proof plan (ProofPlan + ProofPlanStep + ProofStage). Operational until CanonicalProofPlan@1 cutover; must not become a second semantic authority.
items.notes: Schema: ipfs_accelerate_py/agent-supervisor/proof-plan@1. Stages: translate, model_draft, solve, reconstruct, kernel_verify, validate, attest, persist.

items.name: PortfolioPlan (multi_prover_router)
items.role: Supervisor multi-prover portfolio scheduling surface. Routing and isolation only; datasets owns semantic interpretation.
items.notes: Projected through SupervisorCanonicalLogicAdapter; not CanonicalProofPlan@1.

items.name: TrustedProofReceipt
items.role: Plan-named terminal trusted receipt after translation validation, reconstruction, and kernel checking. Datasets owns receipt identity semantics.
items.notes: Exact module path not observed as a distinct type name in accelerate imports; live supervisor type is ProofReceipt. Relationship must be confirmed when datasets source is mounted.

items.name: ProofReceipt (supervisor)
items.role: Supervisor immutable proof result binding obligation, plan, attempt, tree, premises, translator/solver/kernel/toolchain/policy, resource budget, verdict, and evidence. Assurance is derived from evidence, never from provider-claimed fields alone.
items.notes: Schema: ipfs_accelerate_py/agent-supervisor/proof-receipt@1. Subject to ten-point admission before completion/merge influence.

items.name: ProofEvidence
items.role: Evidence item with kind, authority, verdict, and bindings. Provider success without adequate kind/authority cannot raise assurance.
items.notes: Maps onto planned orthogonal evidence-kind and evidence-authority axes.

items.name: ProofReceiptAttestation@1
items.role: Binds production ZKP attestations to trusted proof receipts. Attestation is orthogonal to and preserves underlying semantic authority; simulated/stale/mismatched attestations fail.
items.notes: LFV-G063.

items.name: Supervisor ten-point receipt admission
items.role: Fail-closed admission gate: structural validity, content identity, source/tree/environment/policy bindings, translation chain, evidence kind supports verdict, authority ceiling, reconstruction/kernel checks, not stale, not simulated, supervisor policy admits authority.
items.notes: Epic J: SupervisorLogicPlatformClient handshake + typed invocation + ten-point admission.

items.name: CanonicalProofCacheKey@1
items.role: Planned datasets-owned cache-key contract binding source, expression, formalization, slice, obligation, assumptions, bounds, translation, provider, environment, policy, schema, checker, network policy, evidence kind, and authority ceiling.
items.notes: Must reject CID-looking non-CIDs, empty digests, default-string unknown objects, missing semantic fields, cross-environment hits, and candidate-as-kernel entries.

items.name: logic.common.proof_cache
items.role: LPC-G080 evidence path for datasets semantic proof-cache ownership. Canonical key semantics must live here or in companion canonical_cache_key; supervisor must not redefine meaning.
items.notes: LPC-005 conflict policy lists common/proof_cache as read-only production surface.

items.name: VerificationCacheProtocol@1
items.role: Datasets verification-cache protocol unified with immutable proof corpus (LFV-G062). Supervisor adapter projects ProofCacheKey onto verification-cache-key/v1 shape.
items.notes: CANONICAL_CACHE_MODULE = ipfs_datasets_py.logic.backends.cache_protocol.

items.name: ProofCacheKey (supervisor)
items.role: Supervisor content-addressed proof-cache key (obligation, premises, translator, solver, kernel, toolchain, theorem_registry, policy, resource_budget, candidate_tree). Placement and single-flight only; semantic fields must project from datasets key contract.
items.notes: Schema: ipfs_accelerate_py/agent-supervisor/formal-verification-cache-key@1. Cache is not a trust root; hits re-derive assurance from evidence.

items.name: hammers.proof_cache
items.role: Hammer-local proof cache surface listed alongside common/proof_cache. Must not become a second semantic cache-key authority.
items.notes: Also listed: DCEC cec_proof_cache and TDFOL tdfol_proof_cache adapters as family-local caches.

items.name: Family-local proof caches (DCEC/TDFOL)
items.role: DCEC and TDFOL family-local cache adapters. Compatibility/local optimization only; must not redefine CanonicalProofCacheKey@1 semantics.
items.notes: Representative paths: cec_proof_cache.py, tdfol_proof_cache.py.

items.name: proof_repository (planned)
items.role: Planned LPC-081 unified backend-neutral proof repository interface covering plans, attempts, evidence, receipts, counterexamples, attestations, lookup, freshness, invalidation, and lineage.
items.notes: DuckDB may remain an implementation under one public interface.

items.name: external_provers.lazy_installer
items.role: Explicit pinned lazy installer for external provers. Installs require explicit calls with pins/checksums; never during imports, probes, or pure-data loads.
items.notes: LFV-G082 conflict policy: never install during tests/imports; do not mutate system package managers.

items.name: integration.bridges.prover_installer
items.role: Bridge-layer prover installer coordinating focused installation metadata without expanding mutation surface into pure-data imports.
items.notes: Companion to toolchains.py and lazy_installer.

items.name: backends.toolchains / VerificationToolchainRegistry@1
items.role: Pinned toolchain discovery and installation metadata, resource classes, isolation, and adversarial execution constraints. Declaration never implies installed or production-admitted.
items.notes: LFV-G082 interface VerificationToolchainRegistry@1.

items.name: Pure-data import mutation boundary
items.role: Importing contracts, catalog, syntax, formalization, provider protocol, and supervisor adapter must not import solvers, install packages, open the network, start processes, mutate files, probe hardware, or change environment variables.
items.notes: LPC-061 pure_data_import test is the planned enforcement surface. Runtime discovery, install, and execution stay explicit.

items.name: Supervisor provider isolation boundary
items.role: Supervisor owns process isolation (in-process vs subprocess), resource budgets, network_allowed default false, cancellation, and untrusted output bounds. Does not install toolchains on import.
items.notes: Operational ownership only; semantic installer metadata remains datasets toolchains/lazy_installer.

items.name: BoundedToolRunner@1
items.role: Bounded external-tool process lifecycle: isolated workspaces, timeouts, bounded output/paths, no install on import, fake runners for hermetic tests.
items.notes: LFV-G014.

items.name: ir_core.axes (planned orthogonal axes)
items.role: Planned home for orthogonal LogicOperationStatus@1, LogicSemanticVerdict@1, availability, evidence kind, evidence authority, boundedness, and translation preservation.
items.notes: LPC-030/031/032. A succeeded provider response can still carry unknown/advisory; proof authority must not be inferred from operation success.

items.name: LogicOperationStatus@1
items.role: Planned orthogonal operation-status axis (lifecycle of an operation attempt), distinct from semantic verdict.
items.notes: Supervisor AttemptStatus is the live overlapping legacy surface.

items.name: LogicSemanticVerdict@1
items.role: Planned orthogonal semantic-verdict axis (proved/disproved/inconclusive/...), distinct from provider operation success.
items.notes: Supervisor ProofVerdict is the live overlapping legacy surface.

items.name: AttemptStatus (supervisor)
items.role: Live supervisor lifecycle enum: planned, running, succeeded, failed, unsupported, unavailable, timed_out, cancelled, blocked.
items.notes: Must map explicitly onto LogicOperationStatus@1; succeeded does not imply proved.

items.name: ProofVerdict (supervisor)
items.role: Live supervisor semantic result enum: proved, disproved, inconclusive, unsupported, error, cancelled.
items.notes: Maps onto planned LogicSemanticVerdict@1.

items.name: EvidenceKind (supervisor)
items.role: Live supervisor evidence-kind enum without implying trust: unknown, llm_output, atp_candidate, smt_candidate, solver_result, kernel_verification, test_result, static_analysis, cryptographic_attestation, cache_entry.
items.notes: Overlaps planned orthogonal evidence-kind axis; retain through explicit adapters.

items.name: EvidenceAuthority (supervisor proof)
items.role: Live supervisor evidence-authority boundary enum: unknown, provider, llm, atp, smt, solver, kernel, attestation_verifier, validation_runner, cache.
items.notes: Distinct from objectives goal-quality EvidenceAuthority and planner-doctor EvidenceAuthorityClass; those are supervisor-local non-logic proof authorities and must not silently merge.

items.name: AssuranceLevel (supervisor)
items.role: Ordered assurance lattice: unverified < candidate < solver_checked < kernel_verified < attested. Derived from evidence, not provider claim text.
items.notes: Overlaps authority ceiling concerns; LPC-G030 treats evidence authority as orthogonal to operation status.

items.name: TranslationClass (supervisor)
items.role: Live translation-preservation enum projected onto datasets PreservationKind: exact, equisatisfiable, bounded_abstraction, conservative_approximation, heuristic.
items.notes: Maps to planned translation-preservation axis.

items.name: Boundedness axis
items.role: Planned orthogonal boundedness axis. Live practice embeds finite positive bounds on executable provider ops and ResourceBudget fields rather than a single dedicated enum type.
items.notes: Supervisor ResourceBudget is the operational bound carrier; must not substitute for the planned datasets boundedness axis.

items.name: ResourceBudget (supervisor)
items.role: Supervisor operational resource/bound carrier projected to datasets provider budgets. Placement of execution limits, not semantic boundedness authority.
items.notes: Fields include wall_time_ms, cpu_time_ms, memory_bytes, disk_bytes, max_processes, max_premises, max_output_bytes, model_token_limit, provider_quota, network_allowed.

items.name: EvidenceAuthority (goal_quality)
items.role: Supervisor objectives/goal-quality evidence authority vocabulary. Distinct identity from proof EvidenceAuthority; must not silently merge into logic evidence-authority axis.
items.notes: Name collision only. Inventory for LPC-006 will cover broader supervisor semantic-type duplicates; listed here because it overlaps authority enum naming in this slice.
